messages:
Leah H: heads-up — AcmeMobile just escalated: users on iOS are seeing streams drop mid-response when switching from WiFi to cellular. They report partial outputs only (last token chunk), then connection closed. request_id=rid_0a9c2b, trace=tr_9f8a. Customer says reconnecting opens a new stream but there's no resume — app expects continuous SSE.

AcmeMobile (J. Park): we started seeing it after iOS 17.4 rollout. Steps: open chat, start generation, flip the phone from wifi -> cellular while generation running. ~40% of attempts end with partial text and the SSE stops. No 4xx from API, client sees ECONNRESET.

Leah H: adding logs from customer (sanitized):
```
[client] at 14:03:21 - CONNECT /v1/streams?model=gpt-xyz token=xxxx
[client] at 14:03:24 - SSE: data: {"id":"tok_1","text":"The quick brown"}
[client] at 14:03:24 - socket error: ECONNRESET
[client] at 14:03:25 - reconnect attempt 1
```

Raj P: thanks — can you paste the full server-side request headers & the exact curl they used? Also want the ingress/k8s pod logs around trace tr_9f8a. Possible TCP teardown during network switch. Could be client OS aggressively closing connection. :eyes:

Leah H: curl repro I asked the customer to try (they ran this successfully until repro):
```
curl -v \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-xyz&stream=true"
```
They said when they toggle network mid-stream, curl shows `recv() returned 104` and connection closes. No server 5xx in their view.

Emma R: pinging eng-runtime — two asks: 1) does our SSE path emit an explicit `event: stream_end` or similar at the transport layer on normal completion? 2) are we sending keepalive heartbeats on SSE? If not, client OS might decide connection idle and drop during NIC change.

Emma R: quick notes from runtime: SSE uses chunked transfer with occasional zero-length keepalive comments, but the heartbeat interval is 30s. If network blips < 30s the socket can be torn by client OS without sending TLS close. 

Carlos S: customer wants a fix or recommended client mitigation asap. They're on a paid Dedicated plan, flagged as high priority.

Leah H: replicated locally by using a mobile hotspot switch script — can repro ~30% of attempts. Observed server logs show no error, just FIN from client. Example ingress log snippet:
```
[ingress] 2026-02-25T14:03:24Z INFO conn=rid_0a9c2b tls=established bytes=482 last_event=send_chunk
[ingress] 2026-02-25T14:03:24Z INFO conn=rid_0a9c2b FIN from client, no graceful close
[stream-worker] 2026-02-25T14:03:24Z DEBUG rid=rid_0a9c2b kv_cache_hit=false partial_bytes=482 state=orphaned
```

Raj P: that fits client-initiated teardown. Two parallel mitigation paths: short-term client-side workarounds + longer-term platform changes. Short-term recommendations to customer: implement reconnect with idempotent resume token or re-request with `?preserve_state=true` if using Dedicated, or fall back to non-streaming `stream=false` for stability. Also increase client read timeout and send application-level pings (comment lines `: ping\n\n`) every 5-10s.

AcmeMobile (J. Park): resume token? we don't have that in prod. Any server-side header we can use to rehydrate partial state?

Emma R: currently we don't support resumable streaming sessions across network-level disconnects. We do provide best-effort caching for prompt prefixes on the backend but not token-level resume. For Dedicated customers we can enable longer-lived session affinity + optional `preserve_state` flag (requires infra change). Not a quick toggle yet.

Leah H: provided a reproducible mitigation for the app devs: 1) when you detect network change, call client to cancel current stream and immediately re-issue the same prompt to a `sync` endpoint that returns full completion (non-stream). 2) implement exponential backoff reconnect and concat results client-side. 3) set `Connection: keep-alive` and send a 5s application-level SSE comment to keep OS from tearing the socket.

Raj P: engineering follow-ups I'm creating: ENG-4578 increase heartbeat frequency for SSE to 5s on mobile-targeted endpoints; ENG-4579 evaluate resume-token prototype; SRE-312 investigate k8s ingress TCP timeouts during node reassign.

Emma R: can someone with access paste the full ingress pcap or tcpdump for trace tr_9f8a? want to confirm whether TLS session renegotiation happened.

Leah H: uploaded pcap to secure bucket and added link in the ticket (internal link). I also captured the curl debug showing `* recv() returned -1 ECONNRESET (104)`.

Carlos S: flagged to CSM — offering workaround guide and priority engineering review. Customer appreciates the quick triage. :thumbsup:

Leah H: action items for support: 1) send mitigation doc to customer with sample SSE comment ping and curl example; 2) ask them to test `stream=false` as temporary; 3) escalate ENG tickets and share pcap. For engineering: please prioritize heartbeat change for mobile endpoints.

incident-bot: New incident created: INC-2026-118 — Streaming client disconnects (mobile network changes) — priority P2.

Emma R: noted, I'll pick up ENG-4578, will post RFC by EOD and try a quick canary with 5s heartbeats on staging.

Leah H: thanks all — I'll follow up with customer after we have canary results. If we need to ship a fast patch, pls ping the oncall.
